For us, originality isn’t just about where we began; it’s about where we’re headed and how we’ll lead the way. We are originality in motion. Our Corporate Values— Care, Integrity, Passion, Unity, And Excellence —are At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Values Define How We Operate, How We Treat One Another, And How We Engage With Our Partners, Customers, And The Communities We Serve. At Valvoline Global, We Are United In Our Commitment To Treating everyone with care. Acting with unwavering integrity. Striving for excellence in all endeavors. Delivering on our commitments with passion. Collaborating as one unified team. When you join Valvoline Global , you’ll become part of a culture that celebrates creativity, innovation, and excellence. Together, we’re shaping the future of automotive and industrial solutions. The Senior Manager, Marketing serves as the strategic marketing business partner to the KSA and MEA businesses, translating business priorities, commercial plans, annual OGSMs and building blocks into integrated market activation plans. The position leads trade marketing and market activation teams across KSA and MEA, ensuring distributor, customer, trade, event, sponsorship and product launch activity delivers measurable growth, customer engagement, brand consistency and profitable market performance. The role has accountability for both KSA and MEA in maintaining distinct activation plans, budget views, governance rhythms and performance measures, while leveraging shared EMEA Brand, Product Marketing, Digital, Intelligence and COE capabilities. Working closely with Regional GMs, Sales, Finance, Brand, Product Marketing, Digital, Intelligence, Marketing Operations and Global COEs, the role builds a scalable activation model that supports local market needs. Strategic Market Activation Leadership & Business Planning Partner with the KSA and MEA General Managers, Finance and commercial leaders to translate business plans, OGSM and building blocks into clear KSA and MEA activation roadmaps. Maintain separate activation priorities, budget views and performance rhythms for KSA and MEA, ensuring each P&L receives visible marketing ownership. Define market activation priorities across distributors, customers, channels, product launches, sponsorships, events and trade programmes. Establish governance, decision rights and operating disciplines that enable consistent delivery across KSA and MEA while respecting local market requirements. Commercial Partnership Serve as the primary marketing counterpart for KSA and MEA business priorities, ensuring marketing activity supports revenue growth, sell-out, customer acquisition, market development and channel expansion. Influence business planning by providing activation expertise, market feedback, distributor insights and performance analysis. Prioritise requests across KSA and MEA based on commercial impact, readiness, return on investment and alignment with the agreed business plan. Build trusted relationships with Commercial, Sales, Finance, distributors, key customers and regional marketing capability teams. Trade, Channel & Customer Activation Lead the development and execution of KSA and MEA trade marketing, distributor activation, key customer programmes, product launch activation, promotions and market development initiatives. Provide leadership to KSA trade resources and senior MEA trade marketing leads, ensuring clear ownership, delegated decision-making and strong local execution. Ensure campaigns, product value propositions, sponsorship assets and brand toolkits are translated into practical market activation plans for KSA and MEA. Develop and Manage Marketing investment governance by ensuring activities are commercially justified, documented, approved and measured against agreed outcomes. Integrated Marketing Excellence & Localisation Partner with EMEA Brand & Campaign Strategy, Product Marketing, Digital, Intelligence and COE teams to ensure KSA and MEA needs are reflected in regional plans. Ensure regional brand and campaign platforms are adapted appropriately for local language, culture, channel and customer requirements while maintaining brand consistency. Support major regional transitions, product launches and sponsorship activations with clear local execution plans, customer engagement and sales enablement. Feed market learnings back into Brand, Product Marketing, Digital and Intelligence teams to strengthen future propositions, campaigns and commercial priorities. Leadership, Performance & Investment Management Lead, coach and develop the KSA and MEA market activation and trade marketing teams, creating clear accountability across markets and channels. Own activation planning, investment governance and performance measurement for KSA and MEA market activation activity. Monitor budget usage, activation impact, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment, using data and insights to optimise future priorities. Identify execution risks, market gaps and capability needs, recommending corrective actions and improvements to strengthen KSA and MEA activation performance. Education Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commercial Management or a related discipline is required. MBA or advanced business degree is preferred. Experience Significant experience leading trade marketing, customer activation, commercial marketing, channel marketing or market development in complex multi-market environments. (10+ years). Strong commercial acumen, ideally with management of P&L Demonstrated success partnering with GMs and senior commercial leaders to translate business strategy into measurable activation plans and commercial outcomes. Experience leading teams across different markets and influencing stakeholders in a matrixed organisation. Proven experience managing marketing investments, agencies, distributor activation budgets and performance measurement. Experience in KSA, GCC, Middle East or Africa markets is strongly preferred; automotive, lubricants, industrial, B2B distribution or FMCG experience is an advantage. Knowledge, Skills And Capabilities Strong strategic marketing and commercial business acumen, with the ability to operate across different market maturity levels. Expertise in trade marketing, distributor activation, customer engagement, channel development and integrated marketing planning. Ability to translate GM priorities into practical marketing activation roadmaps, building blocks, launch plans and execution standards. Strong financial, analytical and performance management capability, including budget discipline, investment governance and ROI measurement. Strong leadership, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills across multicultural teams and markets. Ability to balance regional standards with local market, customer and cultural requirements. Professional fluency in English is required; Arabic language capability is a strong advantage. Competencies Desired Strategic Mindset - Anticipates market opportunities and translates KSA and MEA business priorities into focused activation plans that support sustainable growth. Business Partnership - Builds trusted relationships with GMs, Sales, Finance, distributors and cross-functional teams, aligning marketing investment with commercial priorities. Enterprise Leadership - Leads across organisational boundaries, connecting regional capabilities with local market execution and creating alignment across KSA and MEA. Results Orientation - Sets clear goals, monitors performance and delivers measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution. Talent Development - Builds team capability through coaching, clear expectations, feedback, empowerment and accountability. Working Conditions, Physical Requirements and Travel Requirements Hybrid office environment with regular interaction across commercial, marketing and functional teams. Regular travel across KSA and MEA may be required to support market visits, customer engagement, distributor reviews, events and leadership meetings. Travel requirement: at least 50%, depending on business needs. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed, global organisation across multiple cultures and time zones. review_candidates.description: Are you a seasoned professional with a proven track record in hotel software sales and a knack for translating technology solutions into tangible benefits? If you're adept at navigating the intersection of hospitality and technology, with a strong background in hospitality IT solutions & sales, we have an exciting opportunity for you to excel in a dynamic Sales role. Position Overview As a DOS, you'll be talking about our cutting-edge technology offerings which help our clients' operational needs. Leveraging your 6-10 years of experience in hospitality IT Sales, specifically in the hotel technology realm, you will play a pivotal role in presenting how our solutions can enhance their efficiency, revenue management, and overall guest experiences. The DOS will be responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, cultivating relationships with key decision-makers, and achieving sales targets within the assigned territory. Your confident familiarity with terms like API, AWS, and cloud is essential to succeed in this role. What You Will Do Ø Enablement Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve revenue targets and expand market presence in the KSA hospitality and F&B industry. Identify and prioritize key accounts and prospects within the territory, conducting thorough research to understand their business needs and challenges. Track sales performance metrics, pipeline activity, and revenue forecasts, providing regular updates and reports to senior management. Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on IT solutions tailored to their specific requirements. Lead the end-to-end sales process, from initial prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, contract closure, and post-sale follow-up. Update CRM time to time for updates. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including pre-sales, marketing, operation support, to ensure alignment of sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs. Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and demonstrations to prospects, effectively communicating the value proposition and benefits of our IT solutions, leveraging your exceptional communication and presentation skills. Utilize your deep understanding of hotel operations to demonstrate how our solutions can streamline front office processes and elevate guest satisfaction. Coordinate with the dealer to ensure that they achieve their sales target. Ø Sales & Market Research Evaluate and validate potential and existing partners, incl. qualifying leads (partnering with Marketing in key initiatives for lead generation and materials). Accelerating the sales process by identifying solutions to customer pain points. If needed, in preparation with/for the sales team, communicate with project management to translate clients’ requirements and smooth transition from sales to implementation. Review new marketing documents for accurate promotion of the product. Ø Strategy & Innovation Maintain thorough knowledge on international hospitality industry trends and developments. Functioning as an ambassador of innovation for the product and company, introducing new industry trends and developments. Ø Documentation & Controlling Manage and control proposal/deal qualification, including quote verification. Keeping product documentation up to date, highlighting the aim and purpose of the product. Ø Product Update yourself on the new product enhancements, integration projects, RFI’s and RFP’s. Providing product knowledge support, translating the technical aspects of the product to the product and pre-sales team and client, being the intermediary between product management and client. Ø Additionally Coalize with Marketing department to discuss sales expectations, help highlight product USP’s, introducing innovative approaches on representation of the company/products, evaluate the methodologies and strategies applied to reach the relevant markets and clients. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Information Technology, or a related field. 10-15 years of hands-on experience in marketing/selling hotel IT solutions, preferably focusing on hospitality and F&B vertical. Strong grasp of property management systems and revenue management strategies etc. Comfortable discussing and explaining technology concepts such as APIs, AWS, cloud solutions, and AI to both technical and non-technical audiences. Proficiency in using Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting purposes. Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex information. Analytical mindset with the ability to address operational challenges with creative solutions. Proactive approach to problem-solving and an aptitude for working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Certifications or additional training in hotel technology and operations are a plus. A high degree of autonomy and self-motivation. Highly structured, outgoing and social person, ready to communicate with employees, customers and partners across different countries and different organizational levels. Benefits What You Will Get From US Exciting job within a creative environment and the opportunity to make a real impact on the business Friendly, motivated and talented multicultural team. Generous compensation package. An individual workplace, of course as much coffee, mate and fruit as you need to get into the flow. An opportunity to grow personally in a fast-growing service company. Shiji provides a challenging and creative environment with a great deal of freedom, responsibility and the opportunity to help shape the company's future. Join Our Sales Team If you're ready to apply your expertise in hotel operations and technology to drive successful sales engagements, we encourage you to apply. This is a unique opportunity to showcase how our technology solutions can transform and elevate our clients' operational capabilities, ultimately contributing to their success.
